message.content:
This editorial illustration serves as a magazine cover. A caricature of a man’s head and hands dominates the center against a black background. He has a wide face, large blue eyes, and a bared-tooth expression. His hands, with fingers pointed inward toward his neck, are positioned below his chin. A jagged, light-blue line resembling an electric spark or lightning bolt connects his two index fingers. In the center of this bolt, under his chin, is a vertical dollar sign shape.

At the top, the large red word "TEMPO" is printed in a serif font. Above it, the text reads "WAWANCARA WALI KOTA SOLO JOKO WIDODO". Below "TEMPO" is "EDISI 16-22 JANUARI 2012". To the left, a light blue circle contains the text "SIAPA PENEMBAK GELAP DI ACEH". Below the caricature, large white text reads "KESETRUM TENDER PROYEK LISTRIK," with the name "Sutan Bhatoegana" in smaller blue text below. The bottom includes a barcode, "MAJALAH BERITA MINGGUAN Rp 27.000", and a rectangular advertisement for "KFC a.m." featuring a food wrap.
